method: Dependents searched in the audit claims of all 101 works and in full text (pdftotext of all PDFs + .tex) for titles, key terms (stratification, minimal-redundancy, 3/R², √3/R, Φ+, Berry, Binet/F1=3, top-third, Mandelbrot, benchmark spectra/cor:spectra) and cross-citations by the authors.
additional_finding: APEX-COL-1 (no_bounded_height_correction) makes the conclusion of W024 Thm 4 (Reduction A') unsatisfiable for any finite state map when required for all odd n > 1, so A' is an empty reduction. This is not caused by A1.

refuted.work_file: All Preprints/2025_03_05_Rigorous Mathematical Proof of the Local Connectivity of the Mandelbrot Set/2025_03_05_Rigorous Mathematical Proof of the Local Connectivity of the Mandelbrot Set.pdf
refuted.text_original: Ключевой шаг: U = {V(c) < x_N} ∩ B(c₀,ε) связно, так как это подмножество связного диска.
refuted.original_quote: Therefore, the intersection U – as a subset of this region – is also connected and contains c0.
refuted.refutation: A subset of a connected set need not be connected. Kernel-checked counterexample {0,1} ⊆ [0,1]: FBS3R.Misc.subset_of_connected_not_connected : ∃ S T : Set ℝ, IsConnected T ∧ S ⊆ T ∧ S.Nonempty ∧ ¬ IsPreconnected S.
refuted.corrected_statement: U = {V < x_N} ∩ B(c0,ε) is an open subset of ℂ containing c0. Its connected component containing c0 is a connected open neighbourhood of c0 in ℂ, because open subsets of ℂ are locally connected. This says nothing about connectedness of M ∩ U, which is what local connectivity of the Mandelbrot set M requires. No correct version of the step yields MLC.
refuted.corrected_lean_status: standard topology (Mathlib: isOpen_connectedComponentIn / locallyConnectedSpace); no APEX id

dependents.reason: MLC conclusion of the paper rests on this step.
Second route (pi_1 = 0 => local connectivity) is itself false (harmonic fan / comb).

checked_not_dependent: Other works mentioning 'Mandelbrot' (W007, W014, W017, W020, W049, W070, W088) only cite Mandelbrot's 1982 book, use it as an image or list MLC as open; none relies on W005.

refuted.text_original: Prop. «Refined odd-step»: если n не top-third, рост высоты ≤ 2.
refuted.original_quote: Proposition 2 (Refined odd-step). If n is top-third then h(3n+1) − h(n) ≤ 3; otherwise the increase is ≤ 2.
refuted.refutation: n = 11: x = log_φ(√5·11) ∈ [6, 6+2/3), so 11 is not top-third, yet h(34) = h(11) + 3. Lean: FBS3R.Collatz.refined_odd_step_counterexample.
refuted.corrected_statement: For every n ≥ 1: h(n) + 2 ≤ h(3n+1) ≤ h(n) + 3 (APEX.Collatz.fibHeight_three_mul_add_one). In each Fibonacci layer [F_k, F_{k+1}) (k ≥ 2), exactly ⌊(F_{k+1} − F_k + 1)/3⌋ integers have gain 3 (APEX.Collatz.card_gain_three). Gain 3 is not confined to top-third n. The superstep drift is h(T n) − h(n) ≤ 3 − ν₂(3n+1) (B3).

dependents.reason: Inequality (2) k_{J+1} − k_J ≤ (2 + I_J) − A_J, Thm 1 (conditional descent) and Thm 5 (B', integrand 2 + I − ν₂) use Prop. 2. The corrected versions use 3 − ν₂ (the paper's Remark 2). Reduction A' (Thm 4) does not use Prop. 2, but its conclusion is unsatisfiable for all odd n > 1 by APEX-COL-1 no_bounded_height_correction.

refuted.text_original: Thm «Uniqueness of the Fibonacci Stratification»: единственное минимально-избыточное беcщелевое разбиение спектра.
refuted.original_quote: Theorem 4.5 (Uniqueness of the Fibonacci Stratification). Among all non-overlapping … convergent ratio a_{n+1}/a_n → r > 1, the Fibonacci partition (with r = φ) is the unique minimally redundant gapless self-similar indexing.
refuted.refutation: The hypotheses are inconsistent. No strictly increasing a : ℕ → ℕ with a 0 = 1 that is closed under addition has a_{n+1}/a_n → r > 1 (FBS3R.FibStrat.no_additively_closed_partition_with_ratio_gt_one). The Fibonacci numbers themselves are not additively closed: F₂ + F₅ = 6 (FBS3R.FibStrat.fib_not_additively_closed).
refuted.corrected_statement: (i) The Fibonacci intervals [F_n, F_{n+1}), n ≥ 2, partition ℤ≥1: every m ≥ 1 lies in exactly one (FBS3R.FibStrat.fib_partition, B30). (ii) The class of additively closed, strictly increasing ℕ-sequences starting at 1 with ratio limit r > 1 is empty, so the uniqueness theorem is vacuous. No uniqueness statement for the Fibonacci partition is proved.
refuted.corrected_lean_status: KERNEL_PROVED in FBS3R-Lean (B30 + A2); no APEX id

dependents.reason: Thm 4.8 (Bell nonlocality from hyperconnectivity) uses Def. 4.7, F_k = F_m + F_n for every pair, which is exactly the false additive closure (fib_not_additively_closed), and §4.6 invokes Thm 4.5.
The partition (B30) is the true residue of A2.

refuted.text_original: Thm «Berry Phase Generates Bell Correlation Function»: для |Φ⁺⟩ = (|00⟩+|11⟩)/√2 получается E(a,b) = −cos θ.
refuted.original_quote: Consider a maximally entangled two-qubit state |Φ+⟩ = (|00⟩ + |11⟩)/√2. … E(a, b) = ⟨Φ+|(σ·a) ⊗ (σ·b)|Φ+⟩ = −cos θ_ab (Theorem 3.3).
refuted.refutation: For Φ⁺: ⟨σx⊗σx⟩ = +1, ⟨σy⊗σy⟩ = −1, ⟨σz⊗σz⟩ = +1 (FBS3R.Bell.bell_Phi_plus, stated for the unnormalised vector with values 2, −2, 2). So E(a,a) = +1 for a = x, not −1.
refuted.corrected_statement: For the singlet |Ψ⁻⟩ = (|01⟩ − |10⟩)/√2: E(a,b) = −a·b = −cos θ_ab (axis values −1, −1, −1: FBS3R.Bell.singlet_Psi_minus; full kernel, CHSH −2√2 and Chern rigidity q = ±1 in W043: B26–B28). For Φ⁺: E(a,b) = a_x b_x − a_y b_y + a_z b_z.
refuted.corrected_lean_status: KERNEL_PROVED in FBS3R-Lean (B25–B28, A3 singlet part); the general Φ⁺ bilinear form is classical and not formalized beyond the axis values

refuted.text_original: Нижнее собственное значение поперечного векторного лапласиана λ₁^V = 3/R², щель Δ = √3/R.
refuted.original_quote: Corollary II.2 (Threshold on S³). On S³(R) the lowest transverse vector Laplacian eigenvalue is λ^V_1 = 3/R², giving Δ(S³(R)) = √3/R. … yielding λ^V_ℓ = ℓ(ℓ+2)/R² for ℓ ≥ 1.
refuted.refutation: ℓ(ℓ+2)/R² is the SCALAR Laplace spectrum on S³(R). For divergence-free (transverse) vector fields the archive's own spectra are curl² = (k+2)²/R² and Stokes k(k+4)/R² (k ≥ 0). 3 occurs in neither, and min curl² = 4/R² (FBS3R.KillingBeltrami.no_three_in_curl_or_stokes_spectrum: (k+2)² ≠ 3 ∧ k(k+4) ≠ 3 ∧ 4 ≤ (k+2)²).
refuted.corrected_statement: (i) In the spectra {(k+2)²/R²} (curl² = Hodge Laplacian on coexact 1-forms) and {k(k+4)/R²} (Stokes), 3/R² does not occur. The minimum of the first is 4/R², at k = 0 (Lean, A4). So the free linearised transverse-gluon threshold is Δ = 2/R, not √3/R (classical: Hodge spectrum of coexact 1-forms on S³ is (ℓ+1)²/R², ℓ ≥ 1; completeness is not formalized). (ii) 3/R² is the first nonzero eigenvalue of the SCALAR Laplacian. APEX-S3-2 proves that degree-n harmonic polynomials restrict to eigenfunctions with eigenvalue n(n+2)/R² (sphLapF_of_harmonic), so n = 1 gives 3/R². Completeness of that spectrum is not formalized. (iii) Any such threshold → 0 as R → ∞ (APEX-S3-2 tendsto_sphEigen), so it bounds no infinite-volume gap (APEX-YM-1 nonuniform_gap_lost).
refuted.corrected_lean_status: vector part KERNEL_PROVED as stated in (i) (FBS3R A4); scalar eigenfunction part APEX-S3-2; spectral completeness not formalized

dependents.reason: Δ = √3 Λ_QCD ≈ 520 MeV and the glueball hierarchy use λ₁ = 3/R² (A4) and the Fibonacci uniqueness (A2). With the corrected threshold the same convention gives Δ = 2Λ_QCD, which is still heuristic.
The 'lower bound' claim is built on the refuted 3/R² and contradicts APEX-YM-1/S3-2.
The conjecture does not depend on the value of the threshold.

checked_not_dependent: W066 Prop. 15.x and W068 Prop. 16.4 use a 'gap template' √3/R taken from the SCALAR spectrum ℓ(ℓ+2)/R², which is consistent with APEX-S3-2. Both state explicitly that it is not a YM mass gap (W066 #3 and W068 #3 are KERNEL_PROVED no-go). Not dependent on A4, but the label 'gap template' should not be read as a gluon threshold.

refuted.text_original: Thm «Fibonacci scaling»: F_n = (φ^{n+2} − ψ^{n+2})/√5 при F₁ = 3, F₂ = 5.
refuted.original_quote: Theorem 1 (Fibonacci scaling). The shifted sequence (1) [F1 = 3, F2 = 5, F_{n+1} = F_n + F_{n−1}] satisfies F_n = (φ^{n+2} − ψ^{n+2})/√5, so that F_n = φ^{n+2}/√5 + O(φ^{−n}).
refuted.refutation: At n = 1 the formula gives (φ³ − ψ³)/√5 = 2 ≠ 3 = F₁ (FBS3R.Checks.paper_binet_wrong).
refuted.corrected_statement: F_n = Fib(n+3) = (φ^{n+3} − ψ^{n+3})/√5 for all n (FBS3R.Checks.F_binet), hence F_n = φ^{n+3}/√5 + O(φ^{−n}). The ratio limit F_{n−1}/F_n → φ^{−1} (eq. 9) remains true.
refuted.corrected_lean_status: KERNEL_PROVED in FBS3R-Lean (F_binet); no APEX id

refuted.text_original: Cor. «Benchmark spectra» (дополнение): для A_n = A₀e^{−βn} σ² = (A₀/2π²A³)·e^β(e^β+1)/(e^β−1)³.
refuted.original_quote: The exponential family A_n = A_0 e^{−βn}, β > 0, is admissible, with σ² = (A_0/2π²A³)·e^β(e^β+1)/(e^β−1)³.
refuted.refutation: Σ_{n≥0}(n+1)² e^{−βn} = e^{2β}(e^β+1)/(e^β−1)³. The stated value is smaller by exactly the factor e^β (FBS3R.CosmoBench.paper_exp_variance_wrong); it is the value for A_n = A_0 e^{−β(n+1)}.
refuted.corrected_statement: For A_n = A_0 e^{−βn} (β > 0): σ² = (A_0/2π²A³)·e^{2β}(e^β+1)/(e^β−1)³. Equivalently, the paper's expression holds for A_n = A_0 e^{−β(n+1)}. The series identity is kernel-proved (exp_family_sum). The prefactor 1/(2π²A³) is taken from the paper's eq. (variance) and is not formalized.

dependents.reason: Power-law part of the same corollary is correct.
